# Beebo Entertainment
> Free, local-first media server and apps: your own movies, TV, music, photos, audiobooks and live TV, streamed to phones, TVs, cars and browsers, with camp and road-trip features. This file points to our public testing record.

## Testing and progress (updated October 3, 2026)
- [What's new and what's tested (Windows 0.1.79, Android 1.51-tester11, October 5, 2026)](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/whats-tested.html): what changed, platform and feature status, real-device results with dates and tallies, and what is not tested yet.
- [Testing status by feature, % complete and what is left](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/release-evidence.html): five-check progress for every feature, dated history, what passed on real devices, and what is not tested.
- [Machine-readable testing data (JSON)](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/testing-status.json)
- [Known issues and fixes](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/known-issues.html)
- [Feature status: available, beta, in development, planned](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/next-features.html)
- [Reviewed tester results](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/tester-results.html)

## Honesty note
We never claim a flat "100% working". Percentages are checks passed out of checks planned. Untested paths are listed as not tested.
